module.purpose: Provides the Booker-facing React hook that coordinates standard, recurring, and instant booking mutations, success redirects, embed events, instant-meeting state, and booking error presentation.
module.summary: This client-side hook combines Booker store state, form data, React Query mutations, and booking utilities into one booking orchestration boundary. It supports ordinary and recurring bookings, instant meeting creation and polling, rescheduling notifications, payment redirects, success-page redirects, persisted instant-booking recovery, and UI error scrolling. Mutation callbacks normalize booking outcomes into embed events while preserving loading and error state for consumers.
module.businessContext: This supports Cal.com attendee booking and rescheduling flows, including paid and instant meetings. Failure can prevent bookings, payment continuation, success redirects, or recovery of active instant meetings.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A successful dry-run booking is returned by the booking mutation.
A successful booking requires payment and returns a payment UID.
moduleContractTests.then: router.push(createPaymentLink({ paymentUid, date: timeslot, name: fullName, email: bookingForm.getValues("responses.email"), absolute: false }))
moduleContractTests.rationale: Payment-required bookings must enter the payment flow before the success redirect.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An instant booking is successfully created for an event type.
moduleContractTests.then: localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) contains JSON.stringify({ eventTypeId, expiryTime: responseData.expires, bookingId: responseData.bookingId }) and getQueryParam("bookingId") equals responseData.bookingId
moduleContractTests.rationale: Instant meeting continuity depends on persisted booking identity and expiry.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A recurring booking mutation succeeds with at least one booking containing a UID.
moduleContractTests.then: sdkActionManager?.fire("bookingSuccessfulV2", { ...getBookingSuccessfulEventPayload({ ...booking, isRecurring: true }), allBookings: bookings.map((booking) => ({ startTime: booking.startTime, endTime: booking.endTime })) })
moduleContractTests.rationale: Consumers require the recurring success event to include every booking interval.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Creating a booking fails because the reschedule limit was exceeded and replacement reschedule data is returned.
moduleContractTests.then: useBookerStore.getState().rescheduleUid equals error.data.rescheduleUid and bookingData.uid equals error.data.rescheduleUid
moduleContractTests.rationale: The error path must preserve the server-provided reschedule context for retry.
